<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1032
Claimant:
Brandon Williamson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2025-02-15
Claim opened after the insured reported a sdieswipe that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through that office.
2025-02-16
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the other driver's account, which
matches the insured's description of the lane change.
2025-03-02
Photographs from the scene and statements from two independent witnesses were collected. Both witnesses
describe the same sequence of events, and the other driver has confirmed the account without qualification.
2025-06-14
Damage to the claimant's vehicle was inspected. It is mostly confined to the side panels and mirror, which is
consistent with the impact described, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
2025-06-19
Claimant reported a back strain and began treatment through counsel's referral. The injury is consistent in type and
force with a side impact of this kind, and no prior injury to the same area appears in our records.
2025-07-11
A neighbor contacted the office saying the vehicle looked damaged a few weeks before the reported loss. This is a
secondhand recollection with no supporting photos or records, and it has been noted for follow-up without changing
the current assessment.
2025-09-23
Each conversation with the claimant, including the recorded statement, has given the same account of the accident.
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the medical file is being reviewed for the
reasons.
2025-10-03
The driver is confirmed as a named driver on the policy, and covergae applies. Remaining open items are the medical
review and the neighbor's statement, and the file will be updated when counsel responds to the outstanding requests.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
